items.description:
A collection of commercials that aired on Adult Swim on March 10, 2002, originally uploaded by SaiyanBlade84. The commercials aired during an episode of Gundam 0083. They are: 

- Adult Swim will return
- 1-800 CALL ATT: "Hockey"
- Pennzoil: "What kind of guy are you looking for?
